caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded ceramic jug with a narrow mouth and a small handle that attaches near the neck and the upper back of the vessel. The jug has a brownish-gray color with darker and lighter areas, giving a textured and slightly worn appearance. There is a blue floral design painted on the front, consisting of broad leaves and rounded flower shapes. Above the floral motif, some text is visible, reading "COWDEN & WILCOX, HARRISBURG, PA," along with a large number "4" and what appears to be other faint markings or numbers. The body of the jug tapers toward the bottom, ending in a slightly wider and rounded base. The background is an off-white or beige color with slight variations, giving the impression of aged paper.
title: Gray Stone Crockery Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
